# oauth2_password_grant — RFC 6749 §4.3 password grant + cached token
# Verifies: the auth layer posts grant_type=password + username/password
# (form-urlencoded) to the token endpoint, caches the issued bearer, and
# injects Authorization: <redacted> on the data exchange.
# pagination.none → 1 data exchange; events_at: events → 5 events.
# The token endpoint is handled by the auth layer (not traced as an exchange).

replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    initial_interval:
      type: duration
      default: "720h"
    page_size:
      type: int
      default: 5
    token_url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999/oauth2_password_grant/token"
    username:
      type: string
      default: "test-oauth2-user"
    password:
      type: secret
      default: "test-oauth2-password"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  oauth2:
    password_grant:
      token_url: {ref: state.token_url}
      username: {ref: state.username}
      password: {ref: state.password}
      cache:
        store_in: token
        expiry_field: expires_in
        expiry_buffer: 60s

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /oauth2_password_grant/events
    query:
      since: {from_progress: latest_timestamp}

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: events

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  latest_event_timestamp:
    event_time:
      path: timestamp

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","query":{"since":"<from_progress:latest_timestamp>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 348 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/oauth2_password_grant/events"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
{"id":"evt-000001","seq_num":1,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
{"id":"evt-000002","seq_num":2,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:01Z"}
{"id":"evt-000003","seq_num":3,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:02Z"}
{"id":"evt-000004","seq_num":4,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:03Z"}
{"id":"evt-000005","seq_num":5,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:04Z"}
